title: R.A.D® UFO "Choccy Milk" Releases September 17th
excerpt: R.A.D® UFO “Choccy Milk” releases September 17th at £180 / $200, paired with a limited edition Tom Parker Creamery chocolate milk.
content:
Key Details

Release Date: September 17, 2026

  • The Choccy Milk R.A.D® UFO pairs the brand's debut super trainer with a limited edition Tom Parker Creamery chocolate milk.
  • R.A.D® entered the running category in October 2025 with the UFO, its first performance running shoe.
  • Tom Parker Creamery's chocolate milk carries a 3 to 1 carbohydrate to protein ratio used for post run recovery.

The R.A.D® UFO “Choccy Milk” releases September 17th at £180 in the UK and $200 in the US. The chocolate brown and cream super trainer is R.A.D®’s newest colorway for its debut running shoe, launched alongside a limited edition chocolate milk from British dairy maker Tom Parker Creamery.

R.A.D® entered the running category in October 2025 with the UFO, its first performance running shoe, building on a name it had already made in training and CrossFit circles since the brand’s 2019 founding by Ben Massey. The shoe was developed by Tom Berend, R.A.D®’s Head of Design and Innovation and a former lead innovator at Nike’s Innovation Kitchen, working alongside Blue Benadum, the brand’s Head of Running Product and a co founder of the ultra running relay The Speed Project. Massey called the collaboration one of R.A.D®’s coolest yet, said he hopes it sparks “a movement of chocolate milk drinking fiends,” and praised Tom Parker Creamery as making “the greatest chocolate milk on the planet.” For more upcoming drops, check the sneaker release dates hub or browse the latest launch links.

The R.A.D® UFO “Choccy Milk” Design

The chocolate brown and cream colorway wraps R.A.D®’s high cushion UFO chassis, finished with milk inspired details tied to the Tom Parker Creamery collaboration. The chassis is built for maximum energy return and responsive cushioning through demanding long runs. Tom Parker Creamery’s chocolate milk carries a 3 to 1 carbohydrate to protein ratio, the balance distance runners target for post workout muscle recovery.

What Is The Story Behind The R.A.D® UFO “Choccy Milk” Collaboration?

R.A.D® paired its debut UFO running shoe with a limited edition Tom Parker Creamery chocolate milk to celebrate the post run ritual of rewarding a hard training session with an ice cold chocolate milk.

R.A.D® UFO “Choccy Milk” Release Information

The R.A.D® UFO “Choccy Milk” releases September 17th, 2026 at £180 in the UK and $200 in the US. It is sold through uk.rad global.com, launching alongside the limited edition Tom Parker Creamery chocolate milk made for the collaboration.
